stories.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns
stories.summary: Meta has been given a negative outlook by S&P Global Ratings due to the company's hefty capital expenditures and negative free cash flow. S&P said the outlook reflects uncertainty around elevated capital expenditures and future cash flow. Meta reported quarterly earnings last week.
